page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text with a decorative headpiece above the title; no marginal notes. Signature "A 3" at the foot right, page number 5 at the top right.

main_text.head: INTRODVCTIO IN ARTEM IESVITICAM,
A Gabriele Bariaco Lermeo, Nobili Volca, Ad venerandos patres Turnoni eam artem facientes.
main_text.p: LERIQVE non omnino rerum imperiti artem hanc Giesiticam ac eius professores Giesitas appellarunt, nimirum à Giesi, Helisei famulo, qui donorum spiritualium mercedem à Naamano Syro flagitauit. Quæ etymologia quamuis vulgò nonnullis arriserit, à quorum agnatis Icsuitæ munera forsan aucupati erant, à saniori-bus tamen reiicitur, ipsa tum scribendi ratione, tum rerum analogia repugnante. Giesi enim sibi appetiit munera, quæ magna animi constantia Helisceus aspernatus erat: at quidquid Icsuitæ suis artibus hinc inde contrahunt, non tam sibi, quàm Papæ quærere videntur. page.notes: Decorative woodcut initial "D" at the start of the first paragraph, read as the letter D. Printed text "LERIQVE" is as printed for the opening word. "Helisei", "Giesi" and "Icsuitæ" are spelled as printed. The woodcut headpiece is not transcribed. Ornamental elements and the page's faint edge markings were omitted.
